description: Run a ChainGraph decision kernel's compute(policy_parameters) inside a sandboxed, deterministic, in-browser QuickJS-ng WebAssembly VM (ocg-deterministic-compute@2) and return its output_payload. Demo kernel set only -- for the full catalog, use the worker's compute kernels directly. Renders the interactive AINumbers tool as a widget; inputs are applied via the AIN Bridge and the tool runs client-side (zero PII, zero network). Output schema: call describe_tool("run_kernel_vm").

inputs.description: Map of tool input element IDs to values (see manifest input_schema). Applied via AIN Bridge prefill.
